rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child's central transfer provision. Its opening uses the same distinctive formulation, “All functions (including powers, duties, activities, and parts of functions),” followed by an immediate transfer to a newly established federal agency. It then provides for associated transfers of “records, property, facilities, and civilian personnel,” closely paralleling the child's transfer of records, property, facilities, employees, and funds. C01 and C05 are also strong secondary analogues because their Bureau of the Budget disposition clauses closely match section 2 of the child, but C11 has the strongest combined literal and structural correspondence to the principal operative section.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All functions (including powers, duties, activities, and parts of functions) of the Airways Modernization Board ... are hereby transferred to the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Agency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All functions (including powers, duties, activities, and parts of functions) of the Department of Defense ... with respect to the following are hereby transferred to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration
shared_material.explanation: The identical, unusually detailed parenthetical definition and the same operative transfer syntax strongly indicate reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all records, property, facilities, employees, and unexpended balances ... are hereby transferred to the Federal Aviation Agency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: appropriate transfers of records, property, facilities, and civilian personnel shall be carried out
shared_material.explanation: Both pair the transfer of functions with substantially the same categories of supporting administrative assets.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such further measures and dispositions ... as the Director of the Bureau of the Budget shall determine ... shall be carried out in such manner as he shall direct and by such agencies as he shall designate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such further measures and dispositions as the Director of the Bureau of the Budget may deem necessary in order to effectuate the transfers provided for in this section shall be carried out in such manner as he shall direct and by such agencies as he shall designate.
shared_material.explanation: This near-verbatim language appears in C01 and supports its second-place ranking as a likely template for the child's separate implementation section.
